Japan's PM Sanae Takaichi Visits India for the First Time, Seeking New Ties in Indo-Pacific

Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has visited India for the first time, marking a significant development in the region. The visit aims to strengthen ties between Japan and India, two key players in the Indo-Pacific region. The trip comes amid growing tensions with China and the US, and Japan is seeking to expand its influence in the area.
